title: Port-au-Prince march against insecurity and state response

occurrence_and_threshold.finding: Vant Bèf Info reports several hundred people marching in Port-au-Prince; Rhinews independently reports a citizen march but no count.

demands.finding: Participants opposed insecurity/kidnapping and criticized state decrees; source describes a demand for authorities to address insecurity.

response.finding: VBI says police prevented marchers reaching Ministry of Justice; Rhinews describes tear gas after stones were thrown at a patrol.

episode_boundary.finding: Separate same-day Gonaïves march reported; no evidence establishes a single nationwide episode.

notes: Candidate pending review; sources are distinct outlets but source dependency/independence should be checked.

title: Gonaïves march against insecurity and for President Moïse to leave

occurrence_and_threshold.finding: Gazette Haiti reports thousands marching in Gonaïves; Rhinews also describes a Gonaïves march without a count.

demands.finding: Opposition to insecurity and demand that the president leave before Feb. 7.

violence.finding: Gazette describes fires and barricades along the route.

episode_boundary.finding: Do not merge with the Port-au-Prince action absent evidence of same gathering/organizer.

notes: Candidate pending review; city-specific threshold is described by the contemporaneous Gazette report.

title: Attempted Village de Dieu residents demonstration against police operation

occurrence.finding: Search-result summary describes a few dozen residents attempting a demonstration and police preventing it; exact body retrieval timed out, so occurrence details are search-only.

threshold.finding: Search summary says a few dozen, suggesting below 50, but the body was not obtained; exclude only provisionally on search-only evidence.

notes: No body evidence; retained as an unresolved lead, not counted as a qualifying event.
